title: The Free Kick That Turned
coreQuestion: How did Roberto Carlos's 1997 free kick bend the way it did?

facts.claim: Roberto Carlos scored a free kick for Brazil against France at the 1997 Tournoi de France.
The match was played at the Stade de Gerland in Lyon.
Physicists later studied the trajectory of the free kick.

narration.text: This free kick looked like it was going wide. Then it turned.
Roberto Carlos struck it from far out.
The ball swung around the wall, still heading wide.
Physicists later studied how a spinning ball can curve that way.
